name: phase spider
desc: Phase Spider is a CR 3 monstrosity.

actions.name: ethereal jaunt
actions.desc: As a bonus action, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can magically shift from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane, or vice versa.

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. The target must make a [[/save]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average activity=8tRw363NqNSEX3gA]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but &Reference[poisoned] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=8tRw363NqNSEX3gA]], even after regaining hit points, and is &Reference[paralyzed] while poisoned in this way.

actions.name: spider climb
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: web walker
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.
